title: Select None and Select All act only on the customers the search shows
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure Net 30 is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Make sure the shop's own term A, due 15 days after the invoice date, is held by exactly three customers, customer A, customer B and customer C (a new term holds only this case's customers), whose names are in that A to Z order, with credit limits of $500.00, $0.00 and $1,000.00.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Type the last word of customer B's name in "Search customers".
  4. Click "Select None".
  5. Clear the search box.
  6. Click "Select None".
  7. Click "Select All".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • A window titled "Move Customers from term A" opens.

Step 3:

  • Only customer B is listed.

Step 4:

  • Customer B is unticked and the count reads "2 selected".

Step 5:

  • All three are listed again: customer A and customer C still ticked, customer B unticked.

Step 6:

  • All three are unticked and the count reads "0 selected".

Step 7:

  • All three are ticked and the count reads "3 selected".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-R6: “"Select All" ticks, and "Select None" unticks, every customer the search currently matches, including those not scrolled into view. Customers hidden by the search keep their ticks.”
  • S4-R2: “The window shows, top to bottom: a "Search customers" box; "Select All" and "Select None" with "{n} selected" on the right; a scrolling list of every customer on the term, A to Z, each with a checkbox; a "Move To" dropdown; and the buttons "Cancel" and "Move {n} Customers" ("Move 1 Customer" when one is selected).”
